_about: Camera block: wrist (on the robot's hand, in front of the hand body, looking along the gripper and down 28 degrees; 87 degree lens; moves with the hand).
temporal_caption: At 0:00 an egocentric camera on the robot's wrist looks along the gripper: the two gripper fingers hold the rim of the light-blue pitcher at the bottom of the frame, and beyond it the wooden table and the floor of the room. From 0:00 to 0:01 the view swings as the arm carries the pitcher, and the clear glass comes into view ahead on the table. From 0:01 to 0:02 the view tips forward as the pitcher tilts. From 0:02 to 0:05 a thin stream of water runs from the pitcher's lip down into the glass. From 0:05 to 0:06 the view tips back up as the pitcher is set upright, and from 0:06 to 0:07 it swings away from the glass.

aesthetics.composition: Gripper and pitcher rim in the lower part of the frame, the table and glass ahead

cinematography.camera_motion: Moves with the robot's hand: swings, then tips forward and back
cinematography.camera_angle: Looking forward and down from the robot's wrist
cinematography.focus: Pitcher rim and glass in focus

segments.key_changes: The view tips as the pitcher pours
